The '''Sern Prime system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]].
